_howto: Add a destination by appending one object to `places`. `categories` must use ids from the `categories` list above — a place can sit in more than one. `scope` is "international" or "india" and only drives the small badge on the card. Nothing here carries a price: quotes are given on WhatsApp, per the enquiry.
